title: Consultor(a) de Vendas I - Loja Nova América - Rio de Janeiro / RJ
description:
Job description

#SomosMaisNaTIM

Fazer parte da TIM é se conectar com o que acreditamos e ter MAIS sintonia com todo o TIMe. É aprender novas formas de oferecer ao mundo um trabalho com MAIS propósito.

Aprendizado na TIM é MAIS que possibilidade.

É o que nos move a fazer MAIS e melhor. É desenvolver habilidades com criatividade e transformar tecnologia em MAIS liberdade.

Tecnologia na TIM é MAIS que ter a melhor cobertura.

É imaginar as possibilidades com MAIS inovação, conectando todos e todas, com respeito e agilidade.

Diversidade e Inclusão na TIM é MAIS que abraçar.

É uma cultura cada vez MAIS essencial para o nosso dia a dia. É criar um impacto MAIS positivo sendo quem você é.

Vem ser você e fazer parte de um TIMe que tem a coragem para inovar, a liberdade para tentar e a vontade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

#imagineaspossibilidades


Main responsibilities

Descrição do perfil:

Responsável em se manter sempre atento às oportunidades de oferecer a melhor solução de serviços e produtos para cada tipo de cliente, proporcionando a melhor experiência dentro de todos os processos de venda ou pós venda.

Principais atividades:

  • Abordar o cliente de forma gentil, proativa, ágil, dinâmica, realizando um atendimento personalizado garantindo a melhor experiência para o cliente;
  • Incentivar os clientes a utilizarem os serviços disponíveis na Loja (Ex.: autoatendimento, mesa de degustação de aparelhos, outros);
  • Entender genuinamente as necessidades de cada cliente e propor a melhor alternativa de novos produtos/ serviços;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de todos os procedimentos da CIA de venda e pós-venda;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões diárias e semanais;
  • Buscar orientação sobre questões de gestão, carreira e desenvolvimento com o Gerente de Loja;
  • Buscar orientação de vendas, processos e sistemas com o Gerente de Vendas da Loja;
  • Atuar como multiplicador e ser referência;
  • Realizar a grade de treinamento proposta.

Requirements and skills

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação:

  • Experiencia em vendas e atendimento ao cliente

Additional information

Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

Fique por dentro dos nossos benefícios:

• Assistência Médica e Odontológica *

• Benefício Medicamentos *

• Gympass *

• Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição

• Vale Transporte

• Previdência Privada

• Aparelho celular com Internet Ilimitada e franquia de Voz

• Curso de inglês online extensível a 1 familiar ou amigo

• Programa de Treinamento e Capacitação Internos

• Participação nos Lucros

• Meu primeiro benefício - Auxílio para filhos até 2 anos de idade

• Reembolso Creche (para pais ou mães)

• Modelos de trabalho e jornada flexíveis

• Happy Day - Dia de folga no mês do aniversário

E outros!

Somos uma equipe de profissionais qualificados que, combinados com uma frota de embarcações de última geração e especialmente projetadas, prestamos serviços à indústria de Petróleo e Gás.

Nossosvalores :

  • Conduzimos nossos negócios comRESPEITO ;
  • Atuamos sempre comINTEGRIDADE ;
  • Confiamos noTRABALHO EM EQUIPE ;
  • FornecemosEXCELÊNCIA em nossos negócios;
  • Nada é mais importante do que a suaSEGURANÇA e a de seus colegas.

Esta é a função perfeita para você, mas você não atende a todos os requisitos?

Na DOF, valorizamos a pessoa certa para a função, com base em um alinhamento genuíno com a nossa cultura e propósito. Sabemos, por meio de estudos, que minorias frequentemente não se candidatam caso não atendam a 100% dos requisitos — e queremos mudar isso!

Se este for o seu caso, atualize seu currículo com o número do CID.

title: Aprendiz PcD - RJ
description:
Nossa cultura acredita em POTENCIALIZAR SEU POTENCIAL . Oferecemos oportunidades globais para desenvolver sua carreira, tornar sua comunidade um lugar melhor e trabalhar com os pensadores mais inovadores de hoje para resolver os problemas mais complexos do mundo. Acreditamos na flexibilidade para que você explore suas paixões enquanto causa impacto por meio de um trabalho significativo em nossas equipes de trabalho inclusivas. É disso que se trata o #LifeAtCummins .

Estamos em busca de um(a) talentoso(a) Aprendiz para integrar nossa equipe em Rio de Janeiro, RJ – CDBS .

Resumo do trabalho:

Segue os procedimentos e diretrizes estabelecidos para fornecer suporte administrativo eficaz e em tempo hábil a um escritório, unidade de negócios, departamento ou outro grupo organizacional. Desempenha atividades sob supervisão direta.

Responsabilidades chave:

  • Responde a chamadas telefônicas, chamadas de vídeo e recebe mensagens para que os solicitantes/visitantes sejam atendidos com rapidez, cortesia e precisão.

  • Transcreve, digita, formata e revisa uma variedade de materiais (por ex., correspondência, faturas, contratos, atas de reuniões, relatórios, discursos e apresentações) usando software de processamento de texto, apresentação, gráficos e planilhas.

  • Coordena reuniões internas e externas. Isso pode incluir agendamento de reuniões, preparativos de viagens para participantes e a garantia de que várias comodidades para reuniões estejam disponíveis.

  • Gerencia os encontros e programações dos funcionários da unidade.

  • Utiliza equipamentos de escritório, como fotocopiadoras, faxes e impressoras.

  • Realiza outras tarefas administrativas de acordo com as diretrizes e procedimentos estabelecidos, para que essas atividades sejam concluídas com precisão e dentro do prazo estabelecido. As atividades podem incluir a distribuição de correspondência recebida, preparação de correspondência para envio, arquivamento, manutenção de material de escritório ou outro inventário.

Qualifications

Jovem aprendiz.

Responsibilities

Competências:

Valoriza diferenças - Reconhece o valor que diferentes perspectivas e culturas trazem para a empresa.

Orientado para a ação - Assume novas oportunidades e obstáculos difíceis com senso de urgência, muita energia e entusiasmo.

Comunica de modo eficiente - Desenvolve e transmite comunicação de diversas maneiras, de forma a transmitir um entendimento claro das necessidades particulares de diferentes públicos.

Foco no cliente - Constrói relações sólidas com os clientes e fornece soluções orientadas aos mesmos.

Garante responsabilização - Mantém a si mesmo e aos outros responsáveis por cumprir com os compromissos.

Planeja e alinha - Planeja e prioriza o trabalho para concretizar compromissos alinhados aos objetivos da empresa.

Análise de Dados - Descobre, interpreta e comunica dados qualitativos e quantitativos; determina conclusões que dependem do conhecimento dos negócios ou estruturas funcionais; aplica simultaneamente estatística, validade de dados, visualização de dados e abordagens de resolução de problemas para extrair com eficiência padrões significativos e percepções de negócios; apresenta conclusões e resultados que geram decisões de negócios orientadas por dados.

Comunicação de dados e visualização - Constrói um conto do problema de negócios, causa raiz, opções de solução e oportunidades através da ilustração visual de dados, incluindo relatórios e painéis.

Formação, Especializações, Certificados:

Diploma do ensino médio, certificado de conclusão do ensino médio ou experiência equivalente, desde que essa experiência esteja de acordo com os regulamentos aplicáveis.

Experiência:

Requer nível mínimo de experiência ou nenhuma experiência profissional.

Requisitos mandatórios:

  1. Ensino Médio Cursando ou Completo

  2. Idade de 14 a 24 anos

  3. Fácil acesso a Coelho Neto/RJ

  4. Pacote Office básico

Requisitos diferenciais:

  1. Formação em áreas como administração, mecânica, eletrotécnica ou correlatos será considerado um direrencial.

Informações adicionais:

  1. Atuação 100% presencial

title: Moço de Convés (MOC)
description:
Vaga: Moço de Convés – Aliança (Cabotagem)

O que oferecemos:

Oferecemos ótimas oportunidades de carreira com alcance internacional para expandir sua experiência, através de nossas premiadas iniciativas de desenvolvimento de talentos com foco na diversidade. Nosso pacote de remuneração e benefícios é competitivo. Nossa política de licença parental é reconhecida mundialmente como uma das melhores do setor. Investimos continuamente no desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional de nossos colaboradores, promovendo um ambiente de justiça, respeito mútuo, responsabilidade e cuidado com nossos clientes.

No Grupo Maersk, valorizamos a diversidade de talentos e buscamos recrutar as melhores pessoas, promovendo inclusão em todas as suas formas, como gênero, idade, nacionalidade, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência ou crenças religiosas. Orgulhamo-nos de nossa diversidade, que consideramos uma fonte de força para equipes de alto desempenho.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Atender às manobras da embarcação, ocupando os postos escalados, sob orientação do Oficial encarregado;
  2. Responsabilizar-se pela movimentação de equipamentos e aparelhos de manobra e peso nas fainas da embarcação;
  3. Executar serviços de conservação, tratamento, limpeza e pintura do navio, bem como baldeação e adoçamento;
  4. Auxiliar o Contramestre em fainas no convés e, quando faroleiro, distribuir e recolher materiais necessários à faina diária e manutenção;
  5. Responsabilizar-se pela limpeza e conservação do camarote;
  6. Realizar o quarto de serviço conforme determinação do Comandante;
  7. Auxiliar o Oficial de serviço no cumprimento das determinações do Imediato, zelando pela segurança, verificando a amarração, fiscalização de entrada de pessoas a bordo, e cumprimento das normas portuárias;
  8. Fiscalizar operações de carga e descarga, de acordo com o plano de carregamento e instruções do Imediato;
  9. Fiscalizar operações de peação, desapeação, embarque e desembarque de cargas frigoríficas e perigosas;
  10. Possuir Certificado de Competência na Regra STCW II/4 válido, além de certificados no modelo 1034, NR 33 16h, NR 35, Certificado Internacional de Vacinação contra Febre Amarela válido;
  11. Desejável inglês avançado;
  12. Ser organizado, comunicar-se de forma verbal e escrita assertiva, gostar de interagir com equipes e liderados, atuar proativamente em ambientes dinâmicos e críticos, e trabalhar com foco em objetivos e metas.

Requisitos adicionais:

  • Desejável experiência em navios conteineiros.

A Aliança

Integradora logística em todo o Brasil.

Como pioneiros e líderes na cabotagem, e parte da A.P. Moller – Maersk, somos reconhecidos como referência no transporte de carga nacional, atuando com conhecimento técnico, dedicação e experiência.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Skills

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

At Guerbet, we build lasting relationships so that we enable people to live better.

We are a global leader in medical imaging, offering an extensive portfolio of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, as well as digital and AI solutions for diagnostic and interventional imaging. As a pioneer in contrast products for the last 95 years, we continuously innovate.

Customer centricity, Cooperation, Audacity, Focus, and Responsibility are the values that we share and practice.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Computerized Systems Validation Analyst (Pleno level) to join our Quality department. In this role, you will ensure compliance with ANVISA RDC 658, IN 134/22, IN 138/22, and international guidelines by validating computerized systems and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. You will also contribute to audits, inspections, and global projects, playing a key role in maintaining the integrity of our validation processes.
This position is based in Rio de Janeiro, is fully on-site, and is a full-time role.

YOUR ROLE

  • Validate both legacy and new computerized systems.
  • Maintain and update the Computerized Systems Validation Master Plan and Inventory.
  • Prepare full lifecycle documentation: planning, risk analysis, functional/technical specifications, qualification protocols, final reports, and periodic reviews.
  • Support and improve BPx system areas.
  • Evaluate change requests and CAPAs related to system validation.
  • Assist in deviation investigations and CAPA processes.
  • Conduct audits to ensure validated status of embedded BPx systems.
  • Participate in inspections and audits related to computerized systems validation.
  • Support Federal Revenue audits to maintain OEA certification.
  • Present EHS topics monthly in DDS meetings and engage in global projects.

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • Education: Degree in Pharmacy, Systems Analysis, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering.
  • Experience: At least 2 years of experience in Computerized Systems Validation.
  • Advanced knowledge in computerized systems validation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint).
  • Desirable: Knowledge of PLC, HMI, basic programming, IT infrastructure, application servers, and databases.
  • Self-confidence, teamwork, organization, focus, interpersonal skills, and proactivity.

Auxiliar na definição de cronogramas e etapas de montagem baseadas no modelo BIM, garantindo eficiência na execução dos projetos.

Experiência sólida em Revit/BIM, incluindo modelagem de famílias e parametrização avançada

Domínio na leitura, interpretação e desenvolvimento de desenhos técnicos dentro da metodologia BIM

Company Description
Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ?
We are Doctoralia , a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries , responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month!
We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.
Our mission is to “help people live longer, healthier lives”
Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.
Job Description
As a Data Migration Analyst, you will play a crucial role in the company's operations, focusing on processing and analyzing data to be imported into our systems from our clients’ , in a SaaS context.
What you will do in this role:

  • Execute the data migration from a given file (from simple to highly complex) provided by the client into our SaaS;
  • Provide support to employees and clients by resolving data import-related issues;
  • Identify and report bugs in the internal Import Tool, tracking progress until final resolution;
  • Create innovative solutions (including script development) to enhance operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and team productivity;
  • Ensure data security and confidentiality by implementing strict data security practices and policies;
  • Actively collaborate with the team, assisting them in solving complex problems, documenting processes, and providing technical support as needed;
  • Test and validate new solutions developed, offering constructive feedback to promote continuous process improvement.
Qualifications
What makes you a strong fit:
  • Experience with data-centric roles that require extensive technical knowledge;
  • Some experience with technical and non-technical customer-facing interactions;
  • Intermediate English (written and spoken) - plenty of interaction with international teams!
  • Advanced Excel and SQL skills;
  • Knowledge of programming logic, ideally with languages like Python or R;
  • Analytical thinking and the ability to solve complex problems;
  • Ownership, time management skills, and a sense of urgency.
It's even better if you have...
  • A higher education degree in IT-related fields (e.g. Data Processing, Software Engineering);
  • Experience working in a SaaS company with a fast-paced environment.
Additional Information
Our working hours are from Monday to Friday , from 9 am to 6 pm;
And our benefits :
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Vale-Transporte;
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options - eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period).
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: In the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS: OFICIAL REDE - BRASIL
description:
Job description

Se você sempre sonhou em trabalhar em uma das empresas que mais emprega no Brasil, que está em constante transformação e investe em projetos de inovação, essa é sua chance!

Nosso maior desafio é promover e liderar a transformação do modelo de operação e manutenção de redes de Telecom, aportando tecnologia, revisando procedimentos, otimizando recursos e, principalmente, investindo na capacitação e no desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores. Sua missão será:

Realizar lançamentos de cabos metálicos em postes ou dutos, em espaços confinados e rede aérea, auxiliando os cambistas e lideres nas instalações de armários de distribuição, caixas de emendas aéreas ou subterrâneas, espinhar cabos aéreos, retirada rede de cabos e fios e na execução de manutenção preventiva e corretiva e de proteção elétrica (proteção de cabos telefônicos) em toda a rede de acesso de telecomunicações, atendendo os indicadores operacionais definidos pelo cliente contratante e/ou pela companhia.

Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!


Main responsibilities
  • Realizar atividades de instalações e lançamentos de cabos em blocos de dg, entrada de edifício, armários de distribuição e caixas terminais visando facilitar a execução dos trabalhos;
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais de redes utilizados pela equipe, verificando as quantidades existentes, solicitando reposição, objetivando o bom andamento dos serviços;
  • Preparar os cabos no interior das câmaras subterrâneas e/ou rede aérea, efetuando curvatura e dimensionamento para as aberturas, a fim de adequá-los conforme as normas de padronização para a execução de emendas;
  • Auxiliar no trabalho implantação e retirada de postes, realizando escavações com auxilio de ferramentas apropriadas, visando a retirada ou instalação de rede aérea;
  • Preparar locais para realização de serviços em cabos, colocando sinalização de proteção, instalando escadas, andaimes e barracas, retirando tampas e calafetando entradas de caixas subterrâneas, verificando a existência de gases, através de instrumentos;
  • Atuar no corte de cabos aéreos e subterrâneos, quando necessário, em pedaços de comprimento padrão através de maquinas elétricas de corte de grande capacidade, pesagem, padronização dos cabos por bitola e capacidade, para devolução no operador logístico;
  • Dirigir veiculo da empresa, transportando pessoas e/ou materiais, sempre que necessário e quando for definido pela empresa, visando a consecução das atividades afetadass a sua área de atuação;
  • Cumprir todas as normas e procedimentos constantes das orientações relativas a saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho, reportando os desvios ao superior imediato;
  • Realizar atividades em proximidades a rede elétrica e em espaços confinados.

title: Portfolio Analyst
description:
Descrição da empresa

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft acquired Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of Spanish company Elecnor, including nine operational wind farms in Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. This made the company one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing 2.2 GW of installed capacity through acquisitions, constructions, and operations.

The company pioneers in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying the energy's origin via I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), ensuring sustainable operations.

Descrição da vaga

We seek a professional to lead the development and implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book and support commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, considering expansion projects (greenfield and M&A) and R2M opportunities.

As part of this role, you will:

  1. Develop, improve, and maintain portfolio modelling tools;
  2. Propose and evaluate commercial strategies focusing on long-term value and risk mitigation;
  3. Support the Energy Management team with strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  4. Assess Greenfield and M&A projects' impact on the portfolio, including scenarios;
  5. Assist BD and M&A teams in related processes;
  6. Estimate R2M opportunities' impact, incorporating market inputs from commercial teams;
  7. Collaborate with risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement.

Qualificações

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy, or Business Administration;
  • Postgraduate degree in Engineering or Economics;
  • Solid experience in Brazil's electricity sector;
  • Experience in portfolio management;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R/Python coding;
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Job description
Are you excited about finding the best, fitting talents and releasing potential people to help develop Better Collective now and in the future? If yes, then you might be our new colleague as our SEO Content manager.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our content manager at Better Collective Brazil your key objective will be the coordination, production and optimization of content. You will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team working in our offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

Your key objective will be the coordination, production, and SEO optimization of high class content that ranks in Google.

You will become part of an international, highly skilled and dedicated team catering to various user groups, in the broad field of sports betting and Igaming. You will take ownership and responsibility of the websites and products you are working on.

Your main responsibilities as a SEO Content Manager will be:

Coordinate the production of content for several of our top websites & create editorial plan

Optimize content for SEO

Perform keyword studies and develop strategies to address different user groups

Create new content based on business and market priorities

Manage requests to freelancers/writers, proofread their work and provide feedback

Regularly monitor KPIs (rankings, traffic, conversion)

Keep an overview of legal and competitive changes on the market

Closely collaborate with our business development team in order to make sure we have the best deals in place with our partners

Make sure your products / sites have the best interface, you will be able to collaborate with our CRO/UX team to optimize and push our engagement rate up

Make sure your sites are technically performing

Provide your own SEO insights to rank higher in Google.

What do we offer you:

Joining Better Collective, you will become part of a dream team of talented individuals that play each other well. Our workplace is a powerade of caring supportive colleagues who unite over ambitions, curiosity, passion, and our desire to have fun together. With our four company values Integrity, Respect, Ambition and Collaboration we thrive to be a company that is inclusive and a safe place for our employees, with room to be innovative and courageous.

International environment

High responsibility job where you will be able to innovate

A varied everyday life in a fast-paced international business

A lot of great office perks such as snacks and social events.

A professional yet casual working climate with very skilled, passionate and fun colleagues you can imagine

Hybrid policy

Wellhub Platform - Wellness Platform

Hiring model: PJ

Your way to BC

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you want to know more about the job, feel free to contact Diana Figueiredo ( ). We look forward to receiving your application.

About us

We are a global sports media group headquartered in Copenhagen, with 20+ offices around the world and more than 1100+ employees. With our talented employees at the forefront we want to conquer the sports media world and become the leading digital sports media group. We want to bring a unique lens to the world of sports, mixing premium content, proprietary tools, and in-depth analysis to make sports fans with something at stake, smarter about betting. For people that love sports, working at Better Collective is an opportunity to work on something you are passionate about and make work purposeful and fun. For those not into sports, a strong sense of sportsmanship is woven into the organisation and our core values, creating a collaborative, supportive, and fun environment.

Worry that you do not meet all requirements?

Don’t! We are aware that research shows that candidates often tend to avoid job opportunities if they have a feeling of not meeting all the job requirements. Let’s be honest: we don't check all the boxes either. In Better Collective we recognize that everyone is different which we respect and value and therefore, we encourage you to apply for the job, even if you do not find that you are the perfect match. Your unique perspectives and experiences can only make our company even better and help us in our journey to become the world's leading sports media group.

It is better to be equal

We are an equal opportunity employer and diversity is what gives us the little extra we need. We believe diverse teams help us make better products. We hire for cultural growth and welcome people of all genders, ethnicity, ages, stories, nationalities, religions, and backgrounds.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and the community.

Job requirements

Who you are:

You have a keen eye for online content: your editing skills can breathe new life into any copy and your writing is impeccable.

Your insights in analyzing marketing tools (keyword studies, Analytics and Search Console) and optimizing user experience have been tried and tested.

You can recognize yourself in most of the points here:

Familiar with betting and passionate about sports

Speak (and write) English fluently and Portuguese (native from Brasil)

Master’s degree within the fields of Digital Marketing, Communications, Digital Strategy etc.

Minimum 3 years relevant experience e.g. from a content role or in the field of digital marketing (including internships)

SEO editing skills, and flair for proofreading on a variety of topics

UX sensibility in web-products

Excellent communication skills, both written and oral

WordPress CMS experience

Team player

Ability to handle multiple projects at once.

Only CVs submitted in English will be considered for the job!

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:

Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical

14 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.
This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.
We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.
This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.
Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.
Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.
Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing
Leadership and accountability
This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.
As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Especialista TI
description:
A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.
--
PROTEGER É O QUE NOS MOVE
Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL) . É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina.
A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós clicando aqui.
SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Suportar o sistema que atende à operação de Vida em Grupo da Prudential do Brasil;
  • Atender a questões regulatórias com tempestividade e de auditoria com a seriedade e prioridade que requerem;
  • Traduzir as necessidades das diferentes áreas de negócio que utilizam o sistema em requisitos a serem explorados na plataforma de mercado adquirida pela companhia. Sempre com a ótica de maximizar os retornos versus os investimentos necessários;
  • Acompanhar as demandas que viraram necessidades de desenvolvimento do lado do fornecedor, para garantir a entrega no prazo e qualidade esperados;
  • Conduzir com os times internos de TI as validações funcionais e todos os fluxos necessários que permita a devida auditoria do processo de desenvolvimento e mudanças;
  • Liderar projetos e iniciativas estratégicas da área, para entrega de valor para as áreas de negócio;
  • Priorizar e acompanhar o tratamento de incidentes e problemas, fazendo os reportes executivos cabíveis em tempo adequado;
  • Manter comunicação eficaz com as áreas parceiras, incluindo áreas internas de TI e de negócio;
  • Usar análise de dados e métricas para tomada de decisão. Avaliação de desempenho dos produtos e identificação oportunidades de melhoria;
Do que você precisa:
  • Experiência em Sustentação e Evolução de Sistemas, preferencialmente em empresas de seguro;
  • Conhecimento sólido em métodos ágeis, Kanban e Lean;
  • Habilidades de comunicação excepcionais;
  • Experiência prévia com medição de valor, análise de esforço e condução de priorizações.
Será um diferencial se você também tiver:
  • Experiência prévia no segmento de seguros;
  • Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento, análise e gerenciamento da plataforma I4Pro.
Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x2) . Essa posição será baseada no Rio de Janeiro .
NA PRUDENTIAL, VOCÊ PODE CONTAR COM:
  • Assistência médica e odontológica
  • Vale refeição e vale alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo Prudential
  • Participação nos lucros
  • Previdência privada com 100% de complementaridade
  • Auxílio creche ou babá
  • Programa de compra de ações
  • Auxílio Funeral, incluindo cônjuge, filhos, pais e sogros
  • Plataforma de desenvolvimento
Cuidamos também do seu bem-estar:
O Viver Bem é o principal programa de saúde e bem-estar da Prudential, abrangendo as dimensões física, mental e financeira. Nosso objetivo é promover o autocuidado e proporcionar saúde e bem-estar integral aos nossos colaboradores. Os principais serviços oferecidos incluem:
  • Horário flexível
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Fully e Wellhub: Plataformas para você se cuidar por inteiro, que estimula a atividade física, o cuidado com a saúde mental e financeira.
  • Incentivo financeiro às práticas de atividades físicas
  • Espaço Viver Bem: Ambiente projetado para promover a saúde e o bem-estar;
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por Tempo de Casa
  • Viver Bem+: Acesso gratuito a consultas médicas, nutricionista, coach esportivo, acompanhamento a gestantes e atendimento psicológico.
  • Campanha de vacinação nos escritórios
  • Programa de apoio ao colaborador e seus dependentes com aconselhamento financeiro, jurídico e psicológico

title: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP Energy
description:
NEORIS é uma acelerador Digital que ajuda empresas a entrar no futuro, temos mais de 20 anos de experiência como Parceiros Digitais de algumas das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, temos uma cultura de startup multicultural onde cultivamos inovação e aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes.
Procuramos por Arquiteto(a) de Soluções SAP Energy (IS-U), contrato CLT, vaga híbrida para atuação na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções SAP Energy (IS-U) para liderar projetos estratégicos de transformação digital no setor de Energia e Utilities. O(a) profissional será responsável pelo desenho de soluções ponta a ponta, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas SAP e às necessidades específicas de cada cliente, atuando em sinergia com equipes funcionais, técnicas e de negócios.
Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenho da arquitetura de soluções SAP Energy (IS-U/CCS) em projetos de implementação, rollout ou evolução;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e funcional nos módulos IS-U (DM, CRM, IDE, Billing, Invoicing, FICA, EDM, entre outros);
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções SAP viáveis, sustentáveis e escaláveis;
  • Garantir integração entre SAP IS-U e outros sistemas SAP (como S/4HANA, FI, CRM, BW) e sistemas legados;
  • Conduzir workshops com clientes, apoiar definição de roadmap funcional e atividades de pré-venda;
  • Elaborar documentação de arquitetura e participar de revisões de solução;
  • Colaborar com equipes técnicas em definições de desenvolvimento ABAP, interfaces, FIORI, entre outros.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, TI, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) SAP IS-U / CCS em projetos do setor de Utilities (energia, gás, água);
  • Domínio dos processos de Medição, Faturamento, Integração com Medidores, FICA e Atendimento ao Cliente;
  • Experiência em projetos com SAP S/4HANA (integração ou migração ECC → S/4HANA) será considerado um diferencial;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SAP MCfU (Market Communication for Utilities) e SAP Cloud for Energy;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado.
Oferecemos
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação: Benefícios mensais para suas despesas com alimentação, dentro e fora de casa.
  • Previdência Privada: Planejamento de futuro com contribuição complementar à aposentadoria.
  • Plano de Saúde: Cobertura médica de alta qualidade para você e seu dependente legal.
  • Plano Odontológico: Cuidados odontológicos completos, com ampla rede de atendimento.
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção e segurança para você e seus entes queridos.
  • Aulas de Inglês/Espanhol: Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas.
  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar.
  • Auxílio Creche: Suporte financeiro para despesas com educação infantil.
  • Neoris Global Campus: Plataforma de desenvolvimento com oportunidades contínuas de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

Role Overview
The Account Executive is tasked with acquiring new clients and expanding existing relationships for a fast-growing web-development studio. Working closely with solution architects, the individual translates business goals into technically sound project proposals and steers each opportunity from first conversation through contract signature.
Day-to-Day Focus
The role begins with targeted outreach to digital-first brands that need custom websites, migrations, or web-app builds. Discovery calls uncover pain points, after which the Account Executive frames scope and budget in language that resonates with both marketing leadership and engineering stakeholders. Internal designers and developers join scoping sessions only after the Account Executive has defined a clear problem statement and timeline. Pipeline data lives in HubSpot; forecasts are updated weekly and reviewed with the Head of Growth. Once projects kick off, the Account Executive stays involved long enough to secure smooth hand-offs and identify expansion opportunities such as feature add-ons or support retainers.

A minimum of three years carrying quota at a web-development agency is essential; closed deals of USD 100 K or more demonstrate the necessary credibility. Proven command of a modern CRM (HubSpot preferred) and crisp written and verbal communication complete the baseline profile.
Additional Perspective
Familiarity with stacks such as React, Next.js, or Laravel, plus an understanding of agile delivery rhythms, will help set accurate expectations and shorten sales cycles. A network in industries that prize scalable web platforms—e-commerce, SaaS, fintech—offers a strong advantage.
Success Markers
Within six months, the Account Executive is expected to close at least two new web-development projects totaling USD 250 K and to grow one existing client by 20 percent. Forecast accuracy should remain above 90 percent, and pipeline hygiene must meet the studio’s data standards.

title: R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)
description:
R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)

R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Our client is expanding its R&D team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and is seeking highly motivated engineers to contribute to the development of cutting-edge drilling technologies for offshore deepwater applications. This opportunity centers on innovation, new product development, and testing—not operations or maintenance.

We are hiring across multiple disciplines to support core technology areas including downhole power generation, coiled tubing/drillstring development, subsea and high-voltage electronics, and advanced testing/integration systems. Ideal candidates will have a solid background in research and development (R&D), system design, and engineering analysis, with hands-on experience in product development for high-reliability environments.

Areas of Expertise We’re Looking For:

  • Mechanical Engineering: Experience in drilling motors, downhole turbines, or subsea pumps for power generation; coiled tubing/drillstring development; familiarity with manufacturing, machining, and supplier coordination.
  • Mechanical Design/Drafting: Proficiency in generating manufacturing drawings for complex drilling or subsea components and coordinating with manufacturers/suppliers.
  • Integration/Test Engineering: Engineers with a mechanical or electrical/electronics focus, experienced in downhole or subsea systems, sensor integration, test equipment design, and data acquisition.

Electrical Engineering:

  • Plasma/High-Voltage Electronics: High-voltage systems for plasma-based drilling. Relevant experience in military, defense, pulsed power, lasers, or nuclear sectors is a plus.
  • Subsea/Downhole Electronics: Development of high-power electronics and embedded systems for subsea applications.

Software/Firmware/Controls Engineering:

  • Firmware Development: Development and validation of high-reliability firmware for oil & gas environments.
  • Controls Engineering: Experience with PLC programming, real-time control systems, test equipment design, and HIL testing. Familiarity with MATLAB, dSPACE, or SPEEDGOAT is advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute R&D projects in alignment with technical specifications, timelines, and budget
  • Design, test, and commercialize innovative drilling tools and systems for offshore use
  • Implement processes and tools that drive excellence and innovation in product development
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams, leadership, and suppliers to ensure successful integration and delivery
  • Manage technical risks and ensure compliance with HSEQ and regulatory standards
  • Produce detailed engineering documentation including drawings, calculations, and technical reports
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation within the R&D team
  • Represent the company’s technical work at conferences to reinforce its position as a technology leader

Our client is growing its footprint in Brazil to address the region’s unique energy challenges. With a focus on offshore and deepwater solutions, the local team is instrumental in developing next-generation drilling systems tailored to this critical market. They work in close partnership with global collaborators and local operators to bring advanced solutions to life.

In this role, you’ll engage in transformative R&D efforts alongside teams in Brazil, Europe, and the USA—contributing to innovations across both conventional and renewable energy domains.

title: Gerente Comercial de Recuperação de Carteira
description:
Horário: De segunda a sexta, das 8h às 18h
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

Vaga: Gerente Comercial de Recuperação de Carteira - Vendas Presenciais | Agro

Local de trabalho: Presencial na sede da empresa - RJ- Centro.

Objetivo da Função:

Recuperar clientes inativos, aumentar o faturamento e garantir a execução diária das metas comerciais, atuando junto com a equipe na linha de frente.

Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia (Mão na Massa):

  • Fazer ligações diárias para clientes inativos e ajudar a equipe a reverter objeções.
  • Acompanhar de perto o desempenho individual de cada vendedor, escutando áudios, analisando conversas no WhatsApp e corrigindo abordagens em tempo real.
  • Treinar a equipe diariamente em técnicas de vendas, argumentação, roteiro de abordagem e follow-up.
  • Criar, ajustar e aplicar scripts de vendas focados na recuperação de carteira.
  • Monitorar os principais indicadores (KPIs): Número de ligações/dia, taxa de reativação, ticket médio por cliente reativado.
  • Realizar reuniões rápidas diárias (Daily de Vendas) com foco em ajustes imediatos.
  • Atuar como vendedor se necessário, ajudando a fechar vendas complexas ou com clientes estratégicos.
  • Repassar feedbacks diários ao time comercial e à direção sobre resultados e ajustes necessários.

Requisitos:

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Histórico de atuação com recuperação de clientes ou vendas ativas.
  • Domínio de CRM (ex: Moskit ou outro equivalente).
  • Boa capacidade de análise de resultados (Excel ou BI simples).
  • Perfil de liderança prática (exemplo no dia a dia, não só gestão de números).

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Alta energia e resiliência para trabalhar com metas agressivas.
  • Facilidade de comunicação e argumentação.
  • Foco em resultado com disciplina diária.
  • Liderança inspiradora: motivar pelo exemplo.
  • Organização e senso de urgência.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas valorizados):

  • Experiência no setor agropecuário.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de SPIN Selling, Inside Sales ou Vendas Consultivas.
  • Vivência em gestão por OKRs ou metas SMART.

Benefícios e Remuneração:

- Salário fixo + comissão sobre vendas da equipe + bônus por metas de recuperação.

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.

Result of Service
The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.
Work Location
Home based
Expected duration
Three (3) months
Duties and Responsibilities
Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is starting a project with the municipality of Congonhas, Minas Gerais, in cooperation with the Municipal Planning and Management Department. This project aims to revise the Master Plan and develop the city's Mobility Plan. To achieve the proposed objective, the "Horizontes Congonhas" project is designed to strengthen public capacity and promote a culture of transparent decision-making based on data and information. This will be achieved through diagnostics, analysis, training and the drafting of plans. The Master Plan and the Mobility Plan wi ll be drawn up with the participation of society, configuring them as social pacts that take into account its interpretation of the strengths, potential and challenges of the city's spaces, seeking to improve the population's quality of life. To properly implement the project, a Data Analyst is required. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Data Analyst will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a. Assist in the elaboration and calculation of variables, indicators and other data and information. b. Extract, process, and analyse data from public databases and statistics - such as those produced by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics and other organizations – and present them in various formats (tables, graphs, charts). c. Elaborate and/or support the creation of georeferenced information. d. Revise all documents produced related to spatial data and information. e. Participate and organize capacity building activities for UN-Habitat and government staff working in the implementation of UN-Habitat’s projects in Brazil. f. Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to collection, production, analysis and management of data, information and urban indicators and support any other studies and research. g. Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions. h. Provide inputs for the identification of project risks. i. Document and maintain an orderly and accessible information file related to all activities undertaken. j. Be responsible for the delivery according to deadlines for each task and conduct administrative and management activities to ensure that projects meet the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget and quality. k. Document expert group meetings, training events and other activities related to the planning, development and implementation of ongoing and new projects. l. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisors. m. Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Data Analyst will support the implementation of the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office of monthly activities’ report.
Qualifications/special Skills
Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in social sciences, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Economics, or related Fields is required. Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Policy, Sociology, Political Science, Geography, Economics, Urban Studies, Statistics, or related fields is required, or four (4) additional years of experience relevant to the position, in addition to the requirement. Work experience:
  • Minimum five (5) five years of progressively responsible experience in project/programme management on urban related themes.
  • Professional and academic experiences on themes related to data analysis, reports and information for public policy, data visualization, data collection, processing and analysis are required.
  • Professional experience in the development of Master Plans and/or Mobility Plans is desired.
  • Experience related to UN and/or any other international agency is an asset. Skills:
  • Proficiency in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, Powerpoint and Outlook) is required.
  • Proficiency in geographic information system (GIS) software such as QGIS or ArcGIS is required.
  • Good handling of software, online platforms and other tools for data visualization is desirable.
  • Good command of programming languages such as R or Python is desirable.
  • Good knowledge on project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
  • Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
  • The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
  • The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
  • The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
  • The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
  • The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
  • The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
  • The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
  • For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese and English is required. Working knowledge of Spanish is desired.
Additional Information
Travel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office. Missions will be coordinated and finances by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. This is a general selection process for all seniority levels, to join teams that focus on open source networking software at Canonical. Apply here if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking at any level - from the Linux kernel IP or eBPF and bridge constructs, to overlay SDN networking like OVS and OVN, to router, switch and radio access technologies such as SoNIC, FRR and DENT, all the way up to telco MANO and 5G Core solutions.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimise Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data centre networking, from bare metal through virt, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
If you have a passion for networking technologies, deep familiarity with Linux networking and awareness of open source community best practices, then you will enjoy our software-defined networking role at Canonical. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, OpenStack, LXD, MAAS and MicroK8s across a broad range of devices and use cases.
These roles include:

  • Kernel Networking Software Engineer
  • OVN Software Engineer
  • SmartNIC Software Engineer
  • Top-of-Rack (ToR) Software Engineer
  • SoNIC or DENT Software Engineer
  • Telco Software Engineer
  • Kubernetes Software Engineer
Location: we have networking software engineering roles in every time zone
What your day will look like
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the latest hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Contribute to shape innovative product strategies
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organisation
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data centre architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Deep understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies - kernel (including eBPF, AF_XDP), OVS, OVN, SoNIC, DENT, Switchdev, DPDK, SPDK, 5G 3GPP, ONF stack, iwd, NetworkManager, etc.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Cloud-native Network Functions, and Container Network Interface plugins
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Title
Sr. Manager, Business Information Security Officer (BISO)
Job Description
Concentrix Corporation is seeking a Brazil Business Information Security Officer to join the Global Security team reporting to the CNX MET GEO Business Information Security Officer – Insider Risk and Compliance team.
The Brazil Business Information Security Officer (BISO) focuses on proactively identifying security and compliance issues/risks to business operation processes in various accounts, drives in executing the controls to deter, detect and mitigate security and insider risks - including establishing capability and mechanisms to monitor and audit information and data protection of both Concentrix and clients as well as compliance level of each process and relevant control item as deployed in the operational environment, The country BISO drives proactively to enhance the fraud and compliance prevention culture and risk-free environment in Concentrix as well as identifies issues that would include but not limited to physical and logical security, data privacy, KPI, CSAT, inbound/outbound calls manipulation, information leakage, etc. impacting business. Typical activities include but are not limited to Risk Management – risk identification, risk assessments, support in development of risk action plans, risk closures, supporting investigations - case documentation, written first-hand reports, involve in-person or remote interview of persons of interest and working outside normal business hours etc., Governance and metrics, Executive presentations, Collaboration with all teams/ departments. Achieves results through direct interaction as well as influencing other internal groups or persons to achieve results.
Qualifications

  • 7 to 10 years of experience working in risk and compliance management, internal security controls, internal/external security assessment or audit, internal or cyber incident investigations.
Advanced English Level is a MUST, Spanish will be a plus
  • Bachelor's/ Masters’ Degree in Information Technology or relevant areas.
  • CISA certified or willing/able to certify within 12 months of employment.
  • Experience in the BPO industry working in quality, security compliance or delivery strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of BPO Business Operation and CRM services delivery processes.
  • Understanding fraud, process non-compliance and incident investigations as well as various risks in the BPO industry.
  • Ability to identify performance and opportunity gaps.
  • Detail oriented with excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate findings to senior team members with appropriate recommendation and action plan raised to address the gaps in an effective & efficient manner.
BISO Responsibilities
  • Drive the highest Integrity and Ethical standards across the staff and the accounts in scope.
  • Provide governance to operations management team and Quality Assurance team for effective and efficient surveillance and monitoring towards pro-active security and business process non-compliance issue identification.
  • Collaborate with respective supporting functions/departments (IT, HR, Facility, Legal, DPO, etc.) to address relevant security issues/risks.
  • Perform internal audit/assessment on regular basis based on different business process compliance management and risk control mechanisms in different accounts to ensure the full compliance as per relevant standard and identify potential issues/risks.
  • Work closely with the operation team to get all identified non-compliance items fixed in a timely manner to drive for closure and proactively propose and deploy extra preventive controls where appropriate.
  • Establish and execute a robust methodology for periodic reviews aiming to highlight the gaps that exist in the operational processes.
  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, root causes of business issues, and/or opportunities.
  • Provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions and suggest improvements to the processes.
  • Review and report the results and present to management team.
  • Ensure partnership with accounts management team for Proactive Compliance Risk Management – identification, assessment, risk action planning, and closures.
  • Coordinate and support Global Security Assessments (GSAs) - a holistic assessment (technology, HR, operations, finance, etc.) of risks being faced by delivery operations and No Notice Inspections (NNIs) conducted against the specific accounts in scope.
  • Participate and involve in assigned investigations.
  • Conduct incidents analytics for assigned areas within the defined timelines.
  • Drive incidents to closure in a timely manner as required.
  • Document learnings from incidents and circulate to relevant stakeholders Work with Client Risk Control Team directly as the security SPOC from CNX.
  • Conduct employee awareness and assist in developing training materials and where necessary assist in specific training.
Accountability
  • Ensure the security and business process compliance in various accounts to meet business and client expectation.
  • Continuously improve the compliance level driven by operational requirement and business growth.
  • Partner/support the country BISO with the completion of various security programs/initiatives in the concerned accounts driven by Insider Risk and Compliance team, including but not limited to the GSA and NNI.
  • Monitor assigned areas of risk ownership ensuring closures are tracked and presented to required stakeholders.
  • Lead and manage the internal review work to achieve the efficiency, effectiveness, and timeliness.
  • Establish governance and cadence as enforced per guidelines.
  • Ensure assigned education sessions are conducted in a timely manner.
